**HTLC Swap Offer — FLOP**

Hi there,

I'm James Martin, and I'd like to propose a trustless swap via Hash Time-Locked Contract (HTLC).

**Offer Details:**

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Asset | FLOP |
| Amount | 48,852 units |
| Settlement | On-chain HTLC |
| Hashlock | SHA-256 |
| Timelock | Negotiable (48h standard) |

**Why HTLC?**
No counterparty risk — funds are locked in a smart contract and released only when the preimage is revealed. If either side fails to fulfill, the timelock refunds automatically. Clean, atomic, no middlemen.

**Terms:**
- I'm flexible on the timelock window — 48 hours is my default, but I'll accommodate your preference.
- Happy to settle on any chain that supports HTLC natively (Ethereum, Bitcoin, Liquid, etc.).
